metadata.question: There was a volcanic plume visible over Mount Etna at 1:37 am local time on February 23, 2021. Did the plume go to the western side?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Target: Mount Etna, Sicily (approximately 37.73°N, 15.00°E) - Date: February 23, 2021, around 1:37 AM local time (UTC+1, so ~00:37 UTC) - Collection: Sentinel-5P (high temporal resolution) or Sentinel-2 (higher spatial resolution but daily pass) - Need to find imagery close to this timestamp - Sentinel-5P TROPOMI has multiple passes per day; Sentinel-2 has ~10:30 AM pass over Europe - Since the plume was at 1:37 AM local, Sentinel-2 at ~10:30 AM might still show ash/SO2 if persistent - Sentinel-5P SO2 data would be ideal for volcanic plume detection 2. Masking strategy: - Early morning volcanic plumes: focus on SO2 band from Sentinel-5P or aerosol/smoke indices - For Sentinel-2: use aerosol bands or RGB for visual detection - No need to mask clouds as we're looking for plume/SO2 signal itself 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Error: - If SO2 column density or aerosol optical depth is 0 or very low = no plume visible (Answer B) - If SO2 is elevated = plume visible (Answer A) - Need to check if data exists for that date/time (C1) and if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Use SO2 column density threshold and directional analysis (west vs. other directions) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Mount Etna location const etnaLon = 15.0; const etnaLat = 37.73; const etnaPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([etnaLon, etnaLat]); // Define analysis region (box around Etna, ~50 km extent) const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([14.5, 37.3, 15.5, 38.2]); // Target date: February 23, 2021 const startDate = '2021-02-23'; const endDate = '2021-02-24'; // Sentinel-5P SO2 data for volcanic plume detection let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/TROPOMI_L3_SO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); const imageCount = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`S5P SO2 images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log('Attempting Sentinel-2 for aerosol detection...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); const s2Count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${s2Count}`); if (s2Count === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Use Sentinel-2 approach with aerosol bands const img = collection.first(); const validPixels = img.select('B1').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels (Sentinel-2): ${validPixels.B1 || 0}`); if (!validPixels.B1 || validPixels.B1 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } console.log('B'); return; } // Process first S5P image const img = collection.first(); // SO2 column density const so2Band = img.select('SO2_column_number_density'); // Sample SO2 at volcano center and western region const centerSO2 = so2Band.sample(etnaPoint, 3000).first().get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const westPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([etnaLon - 0.3, etnaLat]); const westSO2 = so2Band.sample(westPoint, 3000).first().get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const eastPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([etnaLon + 0.3, etnaLat]); const eastSO2 = so2Band.sample(eastPoint, 3000).first().get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Check valid pixels in region const validPixels = so2Band.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = validPixels.SO2_column_number_density || 0; console.log(`Valid SO2 pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (!pixelCount || pixelCount === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for NaN/null values if (centerSO2 === null || centerSO2 === undefined || isNaN(centerSO2)) { console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Center SO2: ${centerSO2 !== null ? centerSO2.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); console.log(`West SO2: ${westSO2 !== null ? westSO2.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); console.log(`East SO2: ${eastSO2 !== null ? eastSO2.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); // Determine if plume went westward // Plume went west if: west SO2 > center SO2 (higher concentration to the west) const plumethreshold = 0.0005; // mol/m^2 const westPlume = (westSO2 !== null && westSO2 > plumethreshold) && (westSO2 > (centerSO2 || 0) * 0.8); console.log(`SO2 elevated westward: ${westPlume}`); if (westPlume) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
